name: Demo_FileWriteArray
summary: This EA is a file-writing utility that collects bid/ask price data and datetime stamps on every tick, storing them in a structured array. Once the array reaches its capacity (20 elements), it writes the accumulated data to a binary file and resets the counter. It serves as a demonstration of MQL5's FileWriteArray function for persisting structured data to disk.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个文件写入工具，在每个tick上收集买价/卖价及时间戳数据，存储到结构体数组中。当数组填满20个元素后，将累积数据写入二进制文件并重置计数器。它作为MQL5的FileWriteArray函数的演示，用于将结构化数据持久化到磁盘。
strategy_analysis: 该EA没有交易策略概念，它不执行任何入场或出场操作，仅作为数据记录工具运行。在每个tick到来时，它获取当前服务器时间、当前品种的买价和卖价，并将这些数据存入一个预分配大小为20的prices结构体数组中。仓位管理和资金管理在此EA中完全不适用，因为它不涉及任何交易行为。当数组计数器达到预设大小时，EA调用WriteData函数将整个数组通过FileWriteArray以二进制格式写入文件，随后将计数器归零继续采集。在EA反初始化时，如果数组中还有未写满的数据（count小于size），也会将剩余数据写入文件以防数据丢失。整体逻辑简单直接，是一个纯粹的数据采集与文件I/O演示程序。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy concept; it does not execute any entry or exit operations and functions solely as a data logging tool. On each incoming tick, it retrieves the current server time, the current symbol's bid and ask prices, and stores this data into a pre-allocated prices struct array with a size of 20. Position sizing and money management are entirely inapplicable since the EA does not involve any trading activity. When the array counter reaches the preset size, the EA calls the WriteData function to write the entire array to a file in binary format via FileWriteArray, then resets the counter to continue collecting data. During deinitialization, if the array contains unsaved data (count less than size), it also writes the remaining records to the file to prevent data loss. The overall logic is straightforward and simple, serving as a pure data collection and file I/O demonstration program.
pros: 结构体数组批量写入文件，利用FileWriteArray高效序列化二进制数据
在OnDeinit中处理未满数组的剩余数据写入，避免数据丢失
代码简洁清晰，作为FileWriteArray的官方示例具有良好的教学价值
pros_en: Batch writing of struct arrays to file using FileWriteArray for efficient binary serialization
Handles remaining unsaved data in OnDeinit to prevent data loss on EA shutdown
Clean and concise code serving as an excellent official demonstration of FileWriteArray functionality
cons: 没有文件写入失败的详细错误处理，仅打印错误码而无恢复机制
数组大小硬编码为20，缺乏灵活性，用户无法通过参数调整缓冲区大小
缺少数据去重或防重复写入机制，若EA重启可能导致文件中出现重复或残缺数据
cons_en: Lacks detailed error handling for file write failures; only prints error code without recovery mechanism
Array size is hard-coded to 20 with no input parameter for user-configurable buffer size
No data deduplication or repeat-write protection; EA restart may cause duplicate or incomplete records in the file
improvements: 将数组缓冲区大小(size=20)改为可配置的输入参数，提升灵活性
增加文件写入成功与否的验证逻辑，写入后读取校验或记录写入字节数以确认完整性
improvements_en: Make the array buffer size (size=20) a configurable input parameter for greater flexibility
Add write verification logic such as read-back validation or logging the number of bytes written to confirm data integrity

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何交易操作，无资金风险
文件操作使用FILE_READ|FILE_WRITE模式，在多实例场景下可能存在文件访问冲突
risk_points_en: The EA performs no trading operations, posing no financial risk
File operations use FILE_READ|FILE_WRITE mode which may cause file access conflicts in multi-instance scenarios
